name: io.github.gamealia/gamealia-mcp
title: Gamealia
description: Publish web games on Gamealia from AI assistants: SDK, autotest, listing, upload. Local or remote.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: The signed-in Gamealia user and the developer account this connection acts on (with the role in it).

tools.name: list_games
tools.description: The account's games: id, slug, title, kind (web, or mobile listing with store links), status, live version, review state of mobile listings and links.

tools.name: get_game
tools.description: One game's listing (texts per locale, tags, age rating, policy) and its latest versions, with the dashboard links. For a mobile listing: the draft being edited, the approved live listing, the store links, the review state and whether the draft has unsubmitted changes.

game.description: The game's slug or id (list_games shows them)

tools.name: get_version_status
tools.description: For a mobile listing (no build), pass game: the state of its latest listing review and the submitted store links. Otherwise: a version's state, its server autotest report (every failed or warned check with the exact fix in its message) and reject reasons with fixes. Pass versionId, or game for its latest version. After complete_upload the state moves from testing to tested or test_failed.

versionId.description: Version id (from start_upload, get_game or get_version_status)

game.description: The game's slug or id (list_games shows them)

tools.name: get_sdk_guide
tools.description: How to integrate the Gamealia SDK into the game's code: the script tag, the required lifecycle calls (init, loadingStop, gameplayStart, gameplayStop), the portal language, ads, player accounts, saves, multiplayer, purchases and chat.

tools.name: get_docs
tools.description: A Gamealia developer docs page in English, by slug (ads, autotest, cli, cloud-save, faq, godot, listing-translation, migrate-from-crazygames, migrate-from-poki, multiplayer, other-engines, permissions, publishing-with-ai, purchases-roadmap, quick-start, requirements, revenue-and-payouts, sdk-reference, support, teams, unity, user-accounts, where-to-publish-html5-games). Without slug, lists the pages.

slug.description: Page slug, e.g. sdk-reference, requirements, autotest, ads, multiplayer

tools.name: create_game
tools.description: Creates a new game (a draft listing) in the account. kind "web" (default) is an HTML5 game played on Gamealia; kind "mobile" is a free showcase listing for a downloadable Android/iOS game that has no web version: it needs storeLinks, has no build, upload, autotest or ads (so no revenue share), and every change is reviewed by a person before it is public. Needs a slug and at least an English title and description; texts accept several locales ({en, es, ...}) and more locales can be added with update_listing. ageRating describes the game's content and is required to submit.

kind.description: web (default): playable HTML5 build. mobile: store-links listing of an Android/iOS game without a web build (multiplayer, adsEnabled, isolation, backendHosts and permissions do not apply). Fixed once created

slug.description: URL name, 3-40 of a-z 0-9 -, also the game's own host <slug>.gamealia.app (cannot change once live)

title.description: Game title, 2-60 characters: an English string, or an object of locale -> text such as {"en": "...", "es": "..."}

description.description: What the game is and why it is fun, 20-2000 characters: an English string, or an object of locale -> text such as {"en": "...", "es": "..."}

controls.description: How to play: keys, mouse, touch, 0-500 characters: an English string, or an object of locale -> text such as {"en": "...", "es": "..."}

texts.description: Developer-written listing text per locale, many at once: {"fr": {"title", "description", "controls"}, "de": {...}}. Locales: en, es, pt-BR, fr, de, it, ru, tr, ja, ko, zh-CN, zh-TW, id, pl, nl, ar, hi, vi, th, uk, cs, ro, hu, sv, el, he, fi, da, nb, ms, fil, bn. Only given fields change; {} approves that locale's machine translation; null removes it. Translate the listing yourself into every locale (same meaning and tone, keep proper nouns).

tags.description: 1-6 categories (genres), up to 8 mechanics (match-3, merge, physics, tower-defense, ...) and attributes (multiplayer, mobile, ...) in one array

orientation.description: Screen orientation the game needs (default any)

ageRating.description: Minimum recommended age, required to submit; judge it from the game's real content and tell the developer. all: nothing violent or scary; 7: mild cartoon violence; 12: non-graphic or fantasy combat, weapons, zombies, horror, mild language; 16: intense or realistic combat, blood, strong language. Guns, explosives and horror are 12 at least. Sexual or suggestive content, gore, hate, real-money gambling and other adult content are not allowed at any rating.

multiplayer.description: Players per room and the room features the code really supports, or null for single player (see get_docs {slug: "multiplayer"})

adsEnabled.description: Show Gamealia ads in this game (revenue share; default true)

isolation.description: coop-coep only for builds that need SharedArrayBuffer (threads)

backendHosts.description: The developer's own servers the game talks to, e.g. mp.example.com or *.example.com

permissions.description: Browser permissions the game needs ([] removes them); takes effect when a version tested with it is approved

storeLinks.description: Mobile listings only: where players download the game. Only the official https Google Play / App Store app links (other parameters are dropped). null or "" removes a store, a missing key keeps it. At least one is needed to submit. Refused for web games.

permissionsJustification.description: Why the game needs `permissions`, for the reviewer (10-1000 characters); required when adding one

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: Changes a game's listing: only the fields given change (texts merge per locale). It covers translations (texts with many locales at once), tags, ageRating, multiplayer, adsEnabled, backendHosts and permissions. Listing text changes are live right away; permissions, isolation and backendHosts take effect when a version tested with them is approved. Mobile listings: storeLinks too, and every change is saved in a draft that is public only after submit_for_review {game} and a person's approval.

slug.description: New slug (only before the game is first live)

tools.name: start_upload
tools.description: Creates a new version of a game and returns shell commands that zip the build folder (index.html at its root) and upload it straight to Gamealia with curl, using a 1-hour upload token for this version only. The commands run in a shell; complete_upload finishes the upload. No file bytes go through MCP. Clients without a shell can upload from the dashboard link in get_game instead. Web games only: mobile listings have no build.

game.description: The game's slug or id (list_games shows them)

buildDir.description: The build folder to zip (default: the current folder); it must contain index.html at its root

notes.description: Release notes: a short changelog of this version, in plain words for players. Required (at least 10 characters) to submit an update to a game that is already live

tools.name: complete_upload
tools.description: After the parts are uploaded (start_upload's commands), joins them and starts the server unpack and autotest (desktop and mobile in a real browser). The result appears in get_version_status.

versionId.description: Version id (from start_upload, get_game or get_version_status)

tools.name: cancel_upload
tools.description: Abandons a version that is still uploading (for example when the build cannot be uploaded from this assistant): it is archived and its partial upload dropped, so a new upload can start.

versionId.description: Version id (from start_upload, get_game or get_version_status)

tools.name: submit_for_review
tools.description: Sends a tested version (versionId) to Gamealia's review: a person checks every version before it goes live. For a mobile listing pass game instead (no versionId, no upload): it submits the current draft (texts, ageRating, cover, thumbnail and at least one store link are required). Submitting is the developer's decision. Updates to a live game or listing need release notes (notes).

versionId.description: Version id (from start_upload, get_game or get_version_status)

game.description: Mobile listings: the game's slug or id (instead of versionId)

notes.description: Release notes: a short changelog of this version, in plain words for players. Required (at least 10 characters) to submit an update to a game that is already live
